I found two ticket numbers on Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes. Both are in shared team files you can open yourself.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025, `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in by tablet for the 04:00 shift at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting their bay assignments by text. Support patched the text-message routing that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through the gate without anyone stepping in. The note also says to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated, `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

Moss's other North notes on Quarrendon don't have ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest covers Thea's follow-up on appointment time vs. gate arrival, and the 23 Mar 2026 note covers the renewal check-in. The 2 Jan 2026 Central handoffs note lists #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is a different company and isn't one of Moss's notes.

I only looked at Moss's files, not Slack channels like #inc-qfl-sev1, so any ticket numbers posted there aren't on this list.
